routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of EAC and COMESA members listed by the embassy, plus a short list of others (e.g. Singapore, Malta, Cyprus, Jamaica), enter without a visa. Check the full list before you go.

other: List taken from the embassy page. Confirm on the immigration portal.

routes.name: Uganda e-Visa (tourist, single entry)
routes.summary: Apply online at least 5 working days before travel. Most approvals take 2 to 3 working days. Valid 3 months from issue. You print the approval letter and bring a passport valid 6+ months. No work on a visitor visa.

other: Embassy page shows a fraud notice saying the correct fee is 50 USD, but the fee isn't clearly listed. Confirm on the portal.

routes.name: East Africa Tourist Visa
routes.summary: One visa for Kenya, Rwanda and Uganda. 90 days, multiple entry, can't be extended. Doesn't cover Tanzania, Burundi or South Sudan.

other: Fee 100 USD per the embassy page. Check the portal for the current fee.

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: Uganda lists transit visas as an e-Visa category. The pages I could read give no fee, length or rules.

other: Fee and stay length not confirmed on an official page

routes.name: Entry Permit Class G2 (employed expatriates)
routes.summary: For foreigners employed in Uganda, including salaried NGO staff. You must show you couldn't find a qualified Ugandan for the job.

other: Proof of failure to hire a qualified Ugandan

routes.name: Entry Permit Class H (residents with outside income)
routes.summary: For people with steady income from outside Uganda who agree not to work or earn income there.

other: Signed promise not to work or earn locally
Police or Interpol clearance issued within 6 months

routes.name: Entry Permits for company shareholders (Classes B1, B2, C, D, E, F)
routes.summary: Shareholders can get a class by sector: agriculture (B1), agro-processing (B2), mining (C1, C2), general trade (D), manufacturing (E) and listed professions like law, medicine and engineering (F).

other: Fees, capital and duration not read for these classes. Check each class page.

routes.name: Entry Permit Class G1 (missionaries and NGO volunteers)
routes.summary: For missionaries and volunteers working for NGOs.

other: Fees and duration not read. Check the class page.

routes.name: Dual citizenship certificate (e-portal service)
routes.summary: Uganda's immigration e-portal lists a Dual Citizenship Certificate service, so dual citizenship exists in some form. Conditions weren't readable on an official page.
